import importlib.util, json, sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/testbed')
test_path = root / 'qa_instances_eval/qtile/backend_x11_core_poll_multi_file_execution_path_lines/files/tests/qa/backend_x11_core_poll_multi_file_execution_path_lines_test.py'

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qa_test_mod', test_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules['qa_test_mod'] = mod
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

probe = mod.DummyBackendX11CoreProbe()

import libqtile.backend.x11.core as core_mod
import libqtile.backend.x11.window as win_mod

orig_motion = core_mod.xcffib.xproto.MotionNotifyEvent
orig_enter = core_mod.xcffib.xproto.EnterNotifyEvent
orig_leave = core_mod.xcffib.xproto.LeaveNotifyEvent
orig_press = core_mod.xcffib.xproto.ButtonPressEvent
orig_access = win_mod.xcffib.xproto.AccessError
orig_window = win_mod.xcffib.xproto.WindowError

core_mod.xcffib.xproto.MotionNotifyEvent = mod.MotionNotifyEvent
core_mod.xcffib.xproto.EnterNotifyEvent = mod.EnterNotifyEvent
core_mod.xcffib.xproto.LeaveNotifyEvent = mod.LeaveNotifyEvent
core_mod.xcffib.xproto.ButtonPressEvent = mod.ButtonPressEvent
win_mod.xcffib.xproto.AccessError = mod._DummyAccessError
win_mod.xcffib.xproto.WindowError = mod._DummyWindowError

TARGETS = {
    ('/testbed/libqtile/backend/x11/core.py','_xpoll'):'libqtile.backend.x11.core._xpoll',
    ('/testbed/libqtile/backend/x11/core.py','handle_event'):'libqtile.backend.x11.core.handle_event',
    ('/testbed/libqtile/backend/x11/window.py','get_wm_type'):'libqtile.backend.x11.window.get_wm_type',
    ('/testbed/libqtile/backend/x11/window.py','get_property'):'libqtile.backend.x11.window.get_property',
}

records=[]

def tracer(frame,event,arg):
    if event=='line':
        key=(frame.f_code.co_filename, frame.f_code.co_name)
        if key in TARGETS:
            records.append({
                'file': 'libqtile/backend/x11/' + Path(frame.f_code.co_filename).name,
                'func': TARGETS[key],
                'line': frame.f_lineno,
            })
    return tracer

sys.settrace(tracer)
try:
    probe._xpoll()
finally:
    sys.settrace(None)
    core_mod.xcffib.xproto.MotionNotifyEvent = orig_motion
    core_mod.xcffib.xproto.EnterNotifyEvent = orig_enter
    core_mod.xcffib.xproto.LeaveNotifyEvent = orig_leave
    core_mod.xcffib.xproto.ButtonPressEvent = orig_press
    win_mod.xcffib.xproto.AccessError = orig_access
    win_mod.xcffib.xproto.WindowError = orig_window

print(json.dumps(records))
PY
